newsitem.title: USA: Guidant sees maintaining gross margins.
newsitem.headline: Guidant sees maintaining gross margins.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Tuesday that it expects to be able to maintain gross margins at their 1996 level.

Guidant reported earnings of $2.08 a share for 1996, excluding special charges, compared to $1.41 the year before. Gross profit, excluding special charges, was 72.8 percent of sales, up 3.2 percentage points from the year before.
"We expect to be able to maintain gross margins at that level," said Chief Executive Ronald Dollens at the Piper Jaffray Medical Device Conference, referring to the gross margin achieved in 1996.

Dollens noted that when Guidant became a publicly traded company in 1994 and its gross margins were 69 percent, the company had said at the time that it expected to be able to maintain gross margins at the 69 percent level.
